high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld." The post features two women standing on a red carpet at what appears to be a formal event. The backdrop includes large, stylized lettering that reads "TONY AWARDS," indicating that the event is the 77th Annual Tony Awards held at the David H. Koch Theater at Lincoln Center. The woman on the left is wearing a short-sleeved, floor-length dress adorned with a pattern of circular, metallic embellishments in shades of gold, silver, and pink. She has short, straight hair and is wearing large, dark sunglasses
